sources_fetched.title: SE Ranking API Pricing: Free Trial, Wallet, Annual Plans

record.name: SE Ranking
record.one_liner: SE Ranking provides an SEO and GEO data platform featuring REST APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) access for AI assistants.

auth.notes: The fetched pages mention API access, credits, and endpoints, but do not describe the specific credential format or authentication method (e.g., API key header) used for requests.

access.notes: Users can start a free 14-day trial or purchase standalone/wallet API plans directly on the website without a required sales contact.

api_surface.notes: The platform offers a Data API (Backlinks API, Domain Analysis API, Keyword Research API, AI Search API, Website Audit API) and a Project Management API, plus MCP server access.

mcp.notes: MCP (Model Context Protocol) access is included in the plans to query live SEO and GEO data through AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Gemini.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve access and a free trial allow getting API credits easily, but the pages do not document the exact authentication mechanism or request headers needed to make successful API calls.

evidence.claim: SE Ranking offers API credits and MCP access across plans, as well as a standalone SEO Data API plan.
Provides a 14-day free trial with 100K API credits, Wallet top-ups, Standalone plans, and MCP support for connecting to AI assistants.
